candidate.text: Thanks for the carp, Ren! I'll cook it up with pondside herbs tonight. See you next time!
Glad it's useful. The pond's been kind lately. Enjoy your supper, Sora.
Thanks for the carp, Ren! I'll cook it up fresh tonight. Want to chat about pond recipes while I'm resting here?
Glad it reached you fresh. The pond's been calm lately, carp are fat. I'd like to hear how you cook them.
I score the carp, stuff it with wild herbs and pond-side greens, then steam it over a low fire. Simple, but the fat keeps it sweet!
Steaming over a low fire, that's clever. I'll keep an eye on the pond shallows — the herbs grow best there this time of year.
Got the carp, Ren — payment's squared. This fresh catch will make a fine pot of stew tonight!
The pond's been kind lately. A stew sounds right for tonight.
I'll toss in some wild herbs from the west lane. Stop by at dusk and I'll save you a bowl!
I'll be there at dusk. Save me a bowl by the pond.
I'll be there at dusk. Save me a bowl by the pond.
